changelog.summary: Fail-closed CMS identity isolation and explicit Generic CMS package delivery for the local beta candidate.

desktop.changelog: Read legacy desktop wizard CMS settings when canonical settings are absent, fail export when selected CMS generation cannot produce a deployment, and declare Content only versus Generic CMS delivery in every new handoff.

publisher.changelog: Validate CMS delivery metadata and the embedded qms-cms-config.json binding to the packaged APP/WEBSITE triple and catalog manifest; visibly distinguish Content only from Generic CMS delivery.

cms.changelog: Bind runtime configuration, catalog manifests, references and offline dataset caches to the authoritative hosted QDN APP/WEBSITE triple and site identity. Legacy or mismatched data fails closed instead of showing another site's posts.
